text.text: Lowsail's tanks are dry while floodwater piles behind Red Sluice. Ilyra Senn's fever ward needs clean water.
Nessa Quill gives you a copy of the stolen order that diverted the flow. Tovan Rusk offers council help in exchange for control; Nessa wants a shared repair.
The market tanks run again. Ilyra Senn fills clinic jars while Nessa Quill watches the shared channel.
Water runs, but Tovan Rusk's council guards ration every bucket. Ilyra Senn counts the clinic's allotment.
The market is closing. Bram Dorr gathers eight families at the landing; your signal has given them a way to high ground.
The stolen order is on your table. Choose how Lowsail will remember the sluice.

A working mark is an optional background that opens trained approaches. Choose one here before visiting the clinic, council, or workshop; visiting a location first begins a journey without a mark. Either way, you can resolve the water crisis and investigate the Archive.
Your canalwright mark is known at the floodworks; carrying your own kit leaves a technical trail in the Archive.
Your field-medic mark is trusted at the landing and gives Mara a professional witness to lean on later.
Your oathkeeper's writ can bind a council transfer, and it will require you to answer for that promise.
Ilyra Senn shows you two silverleaf doses. One can purge the fouled intake at Red Sluice; the other will treat the fever ward once clean water returns.
She entrusts both doses to you if you promise the clinic the first clean water. Diverting them elsewhere will leave her patients waiting.
Tovan Rusk unfolds the stolen water order. His seal can open Red Sluice if the council owns the gate.
His goal is control. Nessa Quill's repair would give every street a share.
Your oathkeeper's writ can make the transfer lawful, but it will leave you answerable for the council's ration rule.
Nessa Quill lays out a cracked gear and one sound brace. She can lend tools once.
The road is short, but the floodworks will punish a careless repair.
Immediate costs: follow the canal adds 1 risk and spends 0 supplies. Paying the scouts spends 1 supply and adds 0 risk.
Keep a supply if you want to repair the sluice. If you evacuate instead, scouts get all eight families across without medicine. Evacuation leaves the clinic without clean water.
The gate grinds beneath floodwater. Tovan Rusk's order bears the mark of a stolen command.
Beyond the gate, one control chamber can decide Lowsail's water.
The control chamber is half flooded. One lever can set the town's future.

Shared repair needs one repair kit (the tools resource), one supply, one silverleaf dose (the medicine resource), and Ilyra's promise. Council control needs Tovan's seal. Evacuation needs one supply or the repair kit (the tools resource) to brace the landing.
An evacuation route can save families, but it leaves the market and its tanks behind.
The scouts used your last supply, so shared repair is unavailable. Your kit can still brace the evacuation landing.
The scouts used one supply, but your own canalwright kit leaves enough material to complete the shared repair.
Your oath requires you to answer for the council valve before you leave the floodworks.
The stolen order bears a stamp naming Tovan Rusk as its owner; that stamp is not the council seal Tovan can grant you.
The forced gate leaks. The flooded tunnel is already rising.
Nessa Quill watches the gauges while the first current enters the lower channel.
The next release decides who receives the water and who must move.
The shared channel holds. Clean water can run to the clinic.
The council valve locks. Tovan Rusk's guards wait for the first ration list.
The high-ground route opens. Bram Dorr's boats can reach the market before the surge.
Ilyra Senn opens the clinic door. The clean flow reaches her jars, but fever patients still need medicine.
Your promise is ready to be kept or abandoned.
Ilyra has treated the fever ward. The patients drink from the first clean jars, and your promise is kept.
Tovan Rusk has water running under council control. Every mark of debt gives him another claim on your work.
The guards enforce the ration rule at every tap. Ilyra's fever ward depends on what the council allows.
Bram Dorr waits with eight families at the last landing. The market stands empty behind them; the final crossing is still ahead.
He needs one last lead through the rain before the road closes.
The crossing is over. Bram counts the families who reached shelter as the rain covers the old market.

The Lantern Archive stands above the canal in a house of blue glass. Archivist Sera Vale, who also owns the stranded Reedway barge and answers for its crew, notices a faded counterseal above Tovan's local mark on the stolen order. She needs two independent pieces of evidence to call a hearing against the upstream authority, Prefect Oren Vask.
Nessa's shared repair gives the order a maintenance trail that can be checked.
Tovan's ration valve carries the official authorization that Oren Vask wants to keep in force.
Bram's family manifest makes the diversion's human cost impossible to file as a mere clerical error.
The Archive case is open. You can visit Reedway's shores and return to the investigation whenever you choose. Travel costs nothing, and your evidence stays with the case.
Sera's stranded barge holds one regulator. Ilyra's clinic sterilizer and Orin's worker ferry both need it. Paths from Reedway commons lead to the barge and both claimants.
You carry Reedway's single regulator, still unassigned. You can install it at Ilyra's clinic annex or Orin's worker landing; each needs the same part.
The recovered regulator powers Ilyra's clinic sterilizer. Orin's ferry remains without the part. Both shores remain open to you.
The recovered regulator powers Orin's worker ferry. Ilyra's clinic remains without the part. Both shores remain open to you.

Sera Vale lays the stolen order under a glass weight. Jalen Rook knows where the night ledger is kept; the seal workroom can trace the hand that authorized the diversion; Mara Venn is hidden below the stacks.

You have enough evidence to call a hearing. Removing Vask requires the night ledger, his counterseal, and either Mara's account or a canalwright's valve reconstruction. You may adjourn to investigate further; choosing a verdict is final.
The case remains open. Step back to the landing if you want to visit Reedway before returning to the evidence; no verdict has been recorded.
Nessa's repair log is the cleanest way into the ledger. It also gives Mara a reason to believe the Archive will protect her.
Your council seal opens the official file. In return for your cooperation, Sera will assume one of your outstanding obligations. You keep the seal as a custody receipt.
After the regulator seizure, Sera refuses to assume your council debt for the official file. You can still investigate through the public stacks.

Mara knows you installed the council's ration rule and refuses an informal deposition. A professional guarantee can earn her trust; a council summons will compel her at the cost of another debt, with her name unprotected.
Bram's family manifest gives the case a public face. Mara can be sheltered with the families even if she never signs a deposition.

Jalen Rook keeps the night ledger behind a loose lantern panel. He moved Vask's copy after dark and will open the panel only if Sera promises that his name will not be the first one entered in the record.
The ledger records a night transfer from Lowsail's intake to Vask's private mill branch. It establishes who benefited, but Vask can still claim the transfer was an emergency measure.
A sealwright's bench holds wax impressions, valve tracings, and a brass gauge. The counterseal above Tovan's local mark can establish whether Vask's office authorized the transfer.

A canalwright can compare the valve tracings with the order: the private mill branch was opened while the emergency spillway stayed shut. That would contradict an emergency diversion without requiring a witness.
Mara Venn sits beside a dead lantern with both hands around a brother's unpaid notice. She copied the order under threat and believes Vask can still reach her family.

Mara recognizes the authority you gave the council. She will not put her name on an informal deposition for you. Offer a professional guarantee, protect her silence, or return to the hall for an official summons.
Your field-medic training gives Mara a way to breathe through the questioning before she decides what she can say.
An oathkeeper's safe-conduct can bind the Archive to Mara's protection, even if Vask's clerks demand her name.

Sera Vale calls the hearing. Oren Vask arrives with a clean coat and an older seal, insisting that the stolen order was an emergency correction. Mara's testimony, if you took it, waits behind the screen.
The shared channel's maintenance marks contradict Vask's correction.
The council ration list puts Vask's office behind every bucket Tovan released.
Bram's family manifest records who paid for the diversion with a roof, a market, and a place to sleep.
Mara's name can remain sealed while the case is published.
Your oathkeeper's writ is still open. Vask can be compelled to answer while Mara remains behind the screen.
Mara's testimony is signed, but no protection covers the name on the page.
Mara appeared under your council summons. She confirms the order but will not look at you; the summons has added another claim on your work.
No witness has entered the record. The documents can still support a negotiated filing.
The Archive's lantern notice reaches Lowsail before the next market bell. You can finish this journey by closing the Archive case, or continue the same journey at Blackglass Works with the record.
You can visit Reedway's shores before deciding whether to continue at Blackglass. Travel costs nothing, and you can return here with the verdict unchanged.
Reedway's single regulator remains on Sera's barge. Ilyra's clinic sterilizer and Orin's worker ferry both need it. Paths from the commons lead to the barge and both claimants.
You carry Reedway's single regulator, still unassigned. You can install it at Ilyra's clinic annex or Orin's worker landing; each needs the same part.
The Reedway regulator powers Ilyra's clinic sterilizer; Orin's ferry remains without the part. Both shores remain open to you.
The Reedway regulator powers Orin's worker ferry; Ilyra's clinic remains without the part. Both shores remain open to you.
The Archive verdict is unchanged, and your work at Blackglass is settled. From this record you can return to Lowsail or visit Reedway's shores.
The notice certifies Nessa's shared repair and gives her a standing claim against another diversion.
The notice puts council rationing under challenge. Tovan's guards still know where you sleep.
The notice enters Bram's family manifest as evidence of why the market was sacrificed.
Mara's name is on the public page. Vask is removed, but the witness now needs protection beyond the Archive's doors.
Vask is named without Mara. Sera seals the copyist's identity while the official answers for the order.
Mara is safe, but Vask keeps his post and the order's authority remains available to anyone who wants it.
Sera files the documents as a negotiated record. No official is exposed, but the next investigator can find the trail.
Mara's name is excluded from the Archive record; the documents carry the case.
The field-medic mark is entered beside Mara's deposition. Your professional duty makes the protection a public promise.
Mara refuses to speak to you outside the record. The hearing used her account, but your summons made her brother's debt into another threat.
The oathkeeper's writ is discharged in the notice; you made the official answer for the promise you bound.

Blackglass Works rises over the upriver channel. Orin Pell, a shift foreman, points to the pressure line; Captain Varo Dey holds the watch roster; Nessa Quill reads the tide marks. The lower shutters will fail unless someone reaches the control room. Tide starts at 0; at 3 the surge arrives. Crossing choices show how much time they take.

For an undamaged repair, reach the controls at Tide 2 or lower and Risk 2 or lower. At Risk 3 or higher, Varo's watch forces a hurried setting that damages the line unless Nessa has agreed to help. At Tide 3, even her help cannot prevent pressure damage.
The shared-water marks give Nessa a maintenance line through the works.
The council seal can open Varo's gate, but his watch will record who used it.
Bram's high-ground rope line reaches the works. Orin can move the workers before the next surge.
The Archive's public verdict is posted at the quay. Lantern patrols are looking for the person who carried it upriver.
The Archive kept its witness behind a seal. The night crew offers a quieter line through the works.
Mara's coerced account follows you here. Nessa will ask for repair in deeds before she lends a hand.
Nessa keeps her distance. The pressure line holds, but you left Mara's coerced summons unanswered.
The pressure line is settled. Nessa and Orin wait for your account before the next boat leaves for Lowsail.
Reedway's single regulator is still on Sera's barge. Ilyra needs it for her clinic sterilizer, while Orin needs the same part for his worker ferry. You can visit either shore before deciding.
You have recovered Reedway's single regulator. Ilyra can use it for her clinic sterilizer or Orin for his worker ferry; both remain unpowered. You can visit either shore before deciding.
At the worker landing, Orin's ferry now hauls heavy freight with the regulator you recovered from the Reedway barge.
The upper-bank workers have received the relief you arranged through the Reedway landing.
You return with the line steady and the works' cover intact.
The line is steady, but the watch has marked the account and will remember this crossing.
You return with the pressure line scarred from the surge. It holds, but the works will need the mark repaired later.
Nessa stands beside you after the crossing. Her repair knowledge made the route safer.
Nessa stands beside you after the crossing. The supply you spent repaired the trust Mara's summons broke.
The reedway divides around a flooded cut. The tide is already climbing the blackglass steps; every crossing action spends another beat before the pressure room.
A public Archive verdict has put lanterns on the open route.
A sealed or provisional Archive record gives the night crew cover, if you can reach it before the water turns.
The provisional record has not named a culprit, but its route marks still open a quiet crossing.
Mara's coerced account keeps Nessa off the rope line. Orin can still get you to the barracks, but the trust repair will be yours to make.
Captain Varo Dey watches the catwalk with a shuttered lamp. A wrong step will put your name in his report before the pressure gates close.
The council's ration mark makes Varo pause. He will accept its seal, but the favor becomes a fresh obligation.
Varo has written the council favor into his ledger. The gate will open for you, but the debt will follow the return.
The public Archive notice has made the watch more alert. Running saves time but draws attention; waiting lets the tide rise.
Orin Pell keeps the workers above the sluice floor. Nessa checks one dry rope for the last turn into the control room.
There is still time to reach the handwheels before the surge.
The next crossing will carry you past the surge. The line will need an emergency release; Nessa's help can keep it from drawing more attention.
The evacuation line makes the workers ready to follow Orin's hand signals.
Nessa remembers that Mara was compelled. She will not call the route safe until you repair the trust that coercion broke.
Nessa takes the rope beside you. The workers will follow her signals through the last turn.
The gallery narrows to a wet ledge above the pressure pipes. The next choice decides whether you move with the current or wait for cover.
A clean setting requires reaching the control room before Tide 3 and with Risk 2 or lower. At Risk 3+, the watch interrupts unless Nessa has agreed to help.
Nessa's shared-repair marks still point to a brace that can carry your weight.
Lanterns sweep the gallery because the Archive's public notice followed you upriver.
The sealed Archive record gives the night crew a cover signal in the gallery.
The provisional record leaves a quiet route open, though nobody can promise how long it will stay quiet.
Three handwheels feed the Blackglass pressure line. Orin calls the sequence from the floor while the tide pounds the lower shutters.
The tide has reached the warning marks. A clean setting is still possible if you act before the next beat.
The tide has filled the warning marks. Only an emergency release or Nessa's practiced hand can hold the line now.
Your route has drawn enough attention that the control room will remember who held the valve.

Nessa has worked these governors for years. Before the surge she can set the line cleanly even under watch; afterward she can hold an emergency release without drawing more attention, but the pressure will still damage the line.
You stand at Lowsail's quay. Blackglass has a working pressure line, and the account you bring back will change who trusts the next crossing.
Reedway's single regulator is still on Sera's barge. Ilyra needs it for her clinic sterilizer, while Orin needs the same part for his worker ferry. You can visit either shore before deciding.
You have recovered Reedway's single regulator. Ilyra can use it for her clinic sterilizer or Orin for his worker ferry; both remain unpowered. You can visit either shore before deciding.
Ilyra's annex has a working sterilizer powered by the regulator you recovered. The treatment benches can stay open after this journey.
The patients in the raised annex have received the care you arranged during the Reedway recovery.
Nessa's shared channel now has a second set of pressure marks to defend against a new diversion.
Varo's watch records the council favor you called in. Council control reaches farther upriver than it did before.
Council control reaches the works, but you left Varo's favor unused.
Orin can extend the high-ground evacuation line toward the repaired works. The families now have another working route upriver.
The public Archive verdict has made the works visible to every patrol between here and the quay.
Mara's coerced testimony is still part of the journey. Nessa measures the new account against what you made her carry.
Nessa's aid survived the crossing. The supply you spent bought a chance to repair the working relationship.
You set the pressure before the next surge and bring back a clean account.
The line holds after the hard crossing. The watch and the pressure scar will shape the next journey.
The line is steady, but the watch will remember the attention you drew on the way in.
Reedway's warning has returned with you. The Blackglass dispatch board is open: publish it for every patrol, or keep it with the night crew.
The public dispatch ledger carries Reedway's warning. Blackglass patrols will move their stores before the next rise.
The night crew kept Reedway's warning off the public board. The quiet route remains known to the people who need it.
The dispatch board hangs between the quay and the night crew's lamp room. Reedway's warning can become a public order or stay with the people who move through the works after dark.
Orin's ferry horn gave the upper-bank crews time to move their stores. Varo wants the warning entered before the next patrol shift.
Sera's quiet towpath carried the warning before the patrol lamps returned. Nessa wants the route kept with the night crew.
One supply can put the warning on every watch roster. One point of Risk can keep it quiet and preserve the night crew's cover.
The public dispatch ledger now carries the warning. Patrols will move stores before the next rise.
The warning stays with the night crew. The quiet route remains available to the people who know its cost.
The raised causeway links Ilyra's clinic annex, Orin's worker landing and Sera Vale's stranded barge. The shores remain open; paths lead back to both Lowsail and Blackglass.
The raised causeway links Ilyra's clinic annex, Orin's worker landing and Sera Vale's stranded barge. A path leads back to the Archive landing, where your case remains open.

The raised causeway links Ilyra's clinic annex, Orin's worker landing and Sera Vale's stranded barge. A path leads back to your Archive record in Lowsail, where you can decide whether to continue at Blackglass.
You can also return to your Archive record in Lowsail. Its verdict and your work at Blackglass are unchanged.

One regulator survived on Sera's barge. Ilyra offers two medicine for restoring the sterilizer; Orin offers two supplies for restoring heavy transport. You can speak with either claimant before deciding. You can also arrange patient care and worker relief without repairing either machine.

You carry the regulator, still unassigned. Ilyra offers two medicine for installing it at the clinic annex; Orin offers two supplies for installing it at the worker landing. Only one facility can have the part.
Ilyra's sterilizer is running in the annex. The regulator cannot also power Orin's ferry.
Orin's heavy transport is running at the landing. The regulator cannot also power Ilyra's sterilizer.
Ilyra's annex patients have received the care you provided, and the beds are back under her watch.
Relief crates have reached the upper-bank workers. Orin's people are distributing the load you arranged.
The upper-bank watch is waiting for a flood warning. You can reach it by ferry horn or by Sera's quiet towpath.
Orin's ferry horn carried the warning upstream. The upper-bank crews are moving their stores before the next rise.
You carried the warning along Sera's quiet towpath. The upper-bank crews heard it before the ferry lamps returned.
Sera has pulled her crew out of your work after the seizure. Hired porters charge more than she did.
Milo Fen rests with his hand dressed. Sera greets you willingly after the care you gave her deckhand.
Milo still wears your dressing, but taking the regulator afterward cost you Sera's goodwill. She keeps her crew away.

Sera Vale, the Archive keeper who also owns this salvage claim, has lashed the barge to a willow stump. Its cargo is ruined, but one pressure regulator survived above the waterline. She is responsible for the crew and needs this work to keep them paid.
Milo Fen sits beside the winch, cradling a crushed hand. Sera has bound it in sailcloth; he needs a proper dressing and support.
The single regulator can power Ilyra's sterilizer or Orin's hauling engine. It cannot be installed in both, so Sera asks how you will take responsibility for it.
The regulator is off the barge and still unassigned. The clinic and worker landing remain open while you consider its destination.
The regulator now turns Ilyra's annex sterilizer; there is no second part for Orin's ferry.
The regulator now drives Orin's ferry engine; there is no second part for Ilyra's sterilizer.
Sera will not accept a lien or credit that would take total debt above four. A seizure closes her discounted relief route.
Sera refuses to put her crew on your relief work after the seizure. You would have to hire more expensive porters.
Milo's hand is dressed and supported. Sera's crew welcomes the person who cared for their deckhand.
Milo's hand still carries your dressing. Sera acknowledges the earlier help, but taking the regulator afterward cost you her cooperation.
Ilyra Senn has moved the fever beds above the flood line. Her cracked steam regulator leaves the sterilizer idle, but patient care can begin before the barge part is found.
The annex sterilizer is still waiting for the single regulator. Orin has asked for that same part for the worker ferry; you can return to the commons before choosing.
Orin's ferry has the single regulator. Ilyra's annex can still treat patients, but its sterilizer must wait for another part.
The sterilizer hisses steadily. Ilyra shared two medicine from the reserve your repair made usable; the treatment benches can stay open.
Imported sterile packs add two debt marks and are available only while the debt ceiling of four is not exceeded.
The supplier will not extend another two marks of credit against your current debt. Ilyra can still use medicine or supplies you bring.
Ilyra's annex patients have received the care you provided, and the beds are back under her watch.
Orin Pell's crew pulls the ferry by hand. Without a regulator, its hauling engine cannot carry the heavy loads that keep the upper bank supplied.
The worker ferry is still waiting for the single regulator. Ilyra needs the same part for the clinic; you can return to the commons before choosing.
Ilyra's annex has the single regulator. Orin's crew can still send relief, but the hauling engine must wait for another part.
The ferry engine hauls heavy loads again. Orin shared two supplies from the freight your repair let the crew unload.
Sera's crew can carry relief for one supply while her cooperation holds. Porters cost two supplies after a seizure; credit remains subject to the debt ceiling of four.
Orin's workers have received the relief load you chose to send, and the landing settles around the ferry.
The upper-bank watch stands above the reed flats. Its crews can move grain and medicine before the flood reaches the low road.
Orin's ferry can sound a warning horn across the bank, but the crew needs one supply to keep the signal boat fueled.
Sera's quiet towpath reaches the watch without the ferry lamps. It will cost one point of Risk to move unseen.
The ferry horn has already warned the upper bank. Storekeepers are moving their stock above the next flood mark.
The towpath warning reached the upper bank before the patrol lamps came back. The watch has marked the quiet route for the next crew.

choices.label: Carry the canalwright's mark
choices.description: Declare your floodwork training and carry your own worn repair kit. This changes the repair and Archive evidence routes.

choices.label: Carry the field-medic mark
choices.description: Declare your trusted triage work. It changes the last evacuation crossing and Mara's deposition.

choices.label: Carry the oathkeeper's writ
choices.description: Declare the writ that can bind a council transfer. Its obligation will follow you into the hearing.

choices.label: Visit Ilyra's clinic
choices.description: Ask for medicine and promise the clinic the first clean water.

choices.label: Hear Tovan's offer
choices.description: Learn what the council will give you for control of Red Sluice.

choices.label: Find Nessa's tools
choices.description: Ask Nessa Quill how to reach Red Sluice before the flood rises.

choices.label: Depart Lowsail
choices.description: Leave before taking responsibility for the water order.

outcome.summary: You depart Lowsail before the water is settled. The dry tanks wait behind you.

choices.label: Promise clean water, then go to Council Hall
choices.description: Take two silverleaf doses: one for the intake, one for the fever ward. Promise Ilyra the first clean water, then walk to Council Hall to hear Tovan's offer.

choices.label: Refuse the promise, then go to Council Hall
choices.description: Leave the clinic's medicine behind without an obligation to Ilyra, then walk to Council Hall to hear Tovan's offer.

choices.label: Depart the clinic
choices.description: Leave Ilyra with dry jars and no promise.

outcome.summary: You leave Ilyra's clinic without medicine or a water promise.

choices.label: Take the council seal
choices.description: Borrow Tovan's authority. The council will own the gate, and the debt will follow you.

choices.label: Refuse council control
choices.description: Reject Tovan's claim and seek Nessa's repair instead.

choices.label: Bind the council transfer to your writ
choices.description: Use your oathkeeper's authority to make the transfer lawful. It costs one debt mark and leaves you answerable for the ration rule.

choices.label: Return to Nessa with the seal
choices.description: Keep the authority you already borrowed and continue preparing.

choices.label: Depart the council hall
choices.description: Leave Tovan's offer unanswered.

outcome.summary: You leave the council hall. Tovan keeps the stolen order and its claim.

choices.label: Check the clinic first
choices.description: Visit Ilyra before taking Nessa's tools. The detour costs no supplies.

choices.label: Use your own canalwright kit
choices.description: Carry your worn kit into the floodworks without spending Nessa's supply or taking her debt. Its worn fittings add 1 risk, but preserve material for the shared repair.

choices.label: Borrow Nessa's repair kit
choices.description: Spend one supply and owe Nessa one mark for a repair kit. Keep one supply and a silverleaf dose for the shared repair.

choices.label: Work without tools
choices.description: Leave with bare hands. It adds risk and may close the flood tunnel behind you.

choices.label: Depart the workshop
choices.description: Leave Nessa's tools and the failing gate behind.

outcome.summary: You leave Nessa's workshop without taking a repair kit.

choices.label: Follow the canal
choices.description: Risk +1; supplies unchanged. Keep a supply for repair. If you later evacuate without scouts, spend one medicine dose to bring all eight families across, or leave one wounded family behind. That dose cannot go to the fever ward.

choices.label: Pay the canal scouts
choices.description: Supplies -1; risk unchanged. If you later evacuate, all eight families can cross without medicine. With a borrowed kit, this spends the last supply required for repair.

choices.label: Turn back from the road
choices.description: Abandon the expedition before reaching the gate.

outcome.summary: You turn back from the canal road. Red Sluice keeps its failing gate.

choices.label: Read the stolen order
choices.description: Use the maintenance marks on Nessa's copy to open the service hatch without damaging the gate.

choices.label: Force the sluice gate
choices.description: Break the lock and move fast. The rising tunnel will add risk.

choices.label: Leave Red Sluice
choices.description: Walk away from the gate and let the town face the flood alone.

outcome.summary: You leave Red Sluice at the gate. Lowsail's dry tanks remain behind you.

choices.label: Repair and share the flow
choices.description: Fit your repair kit and spend one supply plus one silverleaf dose to purge the intake. Send clean water to every street, with the clinic first.

choices.label: Give Red Sluice to the council
choices.description: Use Tovan's seal. Water will flow, but the council will ration it and add another mark of debt.

choices.label: Honor the oathkeeper's writ
choices.description: Put the lawful transfer into the council valve. The water will be rationed, and your writ keeps you answerable for every claim.

choices.label: Open the evacuation route
choices.description: Spend one supply to send families uphill. The market and its water will be left behind.

choices.label: Use the repair kit to brace an evacuation landing
choices.description: Sacrifice your repair kit instead of a supply to open the high-ground route. The town's water stays cut off. Any debt already owed remains.

choices.label: Take the flooded tunnel
choices.description: Enter the flooded tunnel. The current is too strong to survive; this choice will kill you.

outcome.summary: The flooded tunnel takes you before the lever can be set. Lowsail loses its last chance to choose.

choices.label: Leave the control chamber
choices.description: Abandon the lever and return with no resolution.

outcome.summary: You leave the flooded control chamber. Red Sluice stays unresolved.

choices.label: Release shared water
choices.description: Send Nessa's repaired flow downstream to Lowsail's clinic and market.

choices.label: Release council water
choices.description: Send the controlled flow downstream for Tovan's ration list.

choices.label: Signal the evacuation
choices.description: Send the high-ground signal before the flood reaches the market.

choices.label: Abandon the water test
choices.description: Leave before the result reaches Lowsail.

outcome.summary: You abandon the water test. Lowsail never sees what the sluice could do.

choices.label: Bring the shared water to Ilyra
choices.description: Keep the clinic promise and carry the first clean flow to Ilyra's patients.

choices.label: Report the council rationing
choices.description: Return to Tovan and answer for water controlled in the council's name.

choices.label: Organize the high-ground evacuation
choices.description: Return to Bram and move the families beyond the flood line.

choices.label: Deliver the clinic medicine
choices.description: Give Ilyra one medicine bundle and finish the promise you made in the yard.

outcome.summary: Clean water reaches Ilyra Senn's clinic, and medicine reaches the fever ward. Lowsail keeps a shared flow.

choices.label: Finish the clinic account and open the Archive case
choices.description: Give Ilyra one medicine bundle, then carry the resolved order to the Lantern Archive for a second investigation.

choices.label: Leave the clinic unfinished
choices.description: Depart with clean water running but keep the medicine for another day.

outcome.summary: You leave Ilyra's clinic with the water promise only partly kept.

choices.label: Trade your remaining supplies for a clinic exemption
choices.description: Spend one supply and one medicine dose for Ilyra's patients. Tovan exempts the fever ward from rationing and forgives one mark; his control of the market remains.

outcome.summary: Ilyra treats the fever ward with an exemption from the ration rule. Tovan keeps the market's water under council control and records your reduced debt.

choices.label: Sign the council charter
choices.description: Accept the ration rule, add one mark of debt, and finish under Tovan's control.

outcome.summary: Tovan Rusk records the council charter and your remaining debt. Water flows under ration; the fever ward must wait its turn.

choices.label: Sign the charter and open the Archive case
choices.description: Accept Tovan's ration rule and its debt, then carry the resolved order to the Lantern Archive.

choices.label: Leave the charter unsigned
choices.description: Depart with council control in place but refuse to sign its final account.

outcome.summary: You leave the council record unsigned. Its rationing still governs the water.

choices.label: Lead the families onward
choices.description: Use the scouts' marked crossing to guide all eight families to shelter before the road closes.

outcome.summary: Bram Dorr moves eight families above the flood line. Lowsail loses its market but keeps its people.

choices.label: Lead the families and open the Archive case
choices.description: Use the scouts' marked crossing to get all eight families to shelter, then carry the resolved order to the Lantern Archive.

choices.label: Lead seven families across the washout
choices.description: Without scouts or treatment, seven families can cross. One wounded family will remain at the landing awaiting help.

outcome.summary: Seven families reach shelter. One wounded family is left at the landing; Bram must find another boat. The market is lost.

choices.label: Lead seven families and open the Archive case
choices.description: Take seven families across the unmarked washout, leave one wounded family at the landing, then carry the resolved order to the Lantern Archive.

choices.label: Treat the wounded family and take everyone
choices.description: Spend one silverleaf dose to get all eight families across the unmarked washout. This medicine will not reach the fever ward.

outcome.summary: Silverleaf gets the wounded family moving. All eight families reach shelter with Bram, but the fever ward's promised dose went to the crossing. Lowsail's market is lost.

choices.label: Treat the straggler and open the Archive case
choices.description: Spend one silverleaf dose to get all eight families across, then carry the resolved order to the Lantern Archive.

choices.label: Treat the stragglers by field protocol
choices.description: As a trusted field medic, triage the wounded family without spending the clinic's medicine. Risk +1 while you hold the crossing together.

outcome.summary: Your field-medic mark gets the wounded family across without taking medicine from Ilyra's ward. All eight families reach shelter, but the crossing leaves you exposed to the surge.

choices.label: Treat the stragglers and open the Archive case
choices.description: Use your trusted field-medic protocol to get all eight families across without spending medicine, then carry the resolved order to the Lantern Archive. Risk +1.

choices.label: Stay in the floodplain
choices.description: Stay below the flood line while the boats leave. The surge will kill you.

outcome.summary: You stay below the flood line. The surge reaches the market before the last boat returns.

choices.label: Depart the high ground
choices.description: Leave Bram with the families and the final move unfinished.

outcome.summary: You leave the high ground before the evacuation is complete.

choices.label: Enter the Archive hall
choices.description: Investigate the stolen order with Sera Vale. Any evidence already gathered stays with the open case.

choices.label: Visit Reedway before the hearing
choices.description: Visit Reedway's shores, where Sera Vale's crew, Ilyra and Orin need help. Travel costs nothing; you can return to the open Archive case with your evidence intact.

choices.label: Leave the Archive
choices.description: Keep the order and leave the opened case before its investigation or hearing.

outcome.summary: You leave the Lantern Archive before its hearing. The stolen order remains contested.

choices.label: Inspect the diversion ledger
choices.description: Use the public stacks to find the night entry. Risk +1 while Vask's clerks watch the search.

choices.label: Return to Jalen at the night ledger
choices.description: Return to the panel you found earlier and reconsider Jalen's amnesty. The search has already drawn attention; returning adds no risk.

choices.label: File Nessa's maintenance log
choices.description: Use the shared repair's maintenance trail to open the diversion ledger without adding risk.

choices.label: Open the official file with your council seal
choices.description: Give Sera access to the sealed ration file and its night ledger. She assumes one of your obligations for cooperating: debt -1. Keep the seal as your custody receipt.

choices.label: File Bram's family manifest
choices.description: File the families' losses to secure an emergency records request. Sera obtains the night ledger and adds the evacuation manifest to the case, without a public search or added risk.

choices.label: Trace the seal chain
choices.description: Take the order to the seal workroom and compare the official impressions.

choices.label: Seek Mara in the witness cellar
choices.description: Ask the copyist what she saw and decide whether the Archive can keep her safe.

choices.label: Ask Nessa to vouch for Mara
choices.description: Nessa backs your request with the shared channel's repair log. Sera grants Mara and her brother protected lodging, and Mara signs a sealed deposition. No additional resource cost.

choices.label: Order a council summons for Mara
choices.description: Have Tovan compel Mara to testify by threatening collection of her brother's debt. You owe another council favor: debt +1. Her name receives no protection.

choices.label: Shelter Mara with Bram's manifest
choices.description: Use the evacuation families' safe ground to hide Mara. She stays silent, so this adds no evidence.

choices.label: Call the Lantern hearing
choices.description: Two evidence items can open a hearing. To remove Vask, gather the ledger, counterseal, and testimony or technical proof. You may return to investigate until you choose a verdict.

choices.label: Leave the Archive
choices.description: End the investigation without asking the Archive to decide the case.

outcome.summary: You leave the Lantern Archive with the order unresolved. Vask's claim survives the silence.

choices.label: Pause and return to the landing
choices.description: Return to the Archive landing at no cost, keeping your evidence. You can visit Reedway and resume the open investigation before choosing a verdict.

choices.label: Secure Jalen's amnesty
choices.description: Promise the porter that the Archive will protect his testimony, then copy the night ledger.

choices.label: Leave the night ledger
choices.description: Leave Jalen's panel closed and return to the Archive hall.

choices.label: Compare the seal impressions
choices.description: Match the counterseal above Tovan's mark to Vask's office. This proves authorization, though Vask can still claim an emergency.

choices.label: Reconstruct the pressure mark
choices.description: Match Vask's counterseal and reconstruct the valve settings: his private mill branch opened while the emergency spillway stayed shut. With the ledger, this refutes his defense without Mara's testimony.

choices.label: Leave the seal bench
choices.description: Return to the Archive hall without committing the seal comparison.

choices.label: Record Mara's testimony
choices.description: Mara agrees to state that Vask ordered water reserved for his mill and threatened her brother over the copy. Her signed account has no protection; the hearing will decide whether to publish or seal it.

choices.label: Stabilize Mara before the deposition
choices.description: Use field-medic practice to steady Mara and secure protected testimony without spending medicine. Risk +1 while you sign the professional deposition.

choices.label: Swear Mara safe conduct
choices.description: Bind the Archive to Mara's protection before she names the office that coerced her.

choices.label: Keep Mara hidden
choices.description: Move Mara to shelter without taking a deposition. She stays safe and silent; the case gains no evidence.

choices.label: Leave the witness cellar
choices.description: Leave Mara's decision for another visit and return to the hall.

choices.label: Publish Vask's order and name Mara
choices.description: Expose the official with Mara's signed testimony. Vask falls, but the witness's name enters the public record; risk +1.

choices.label: Publish Vask's order anonymously
choices.description: Expose the official while Sera seals Mara's name behind the Archive's protection.

choices.label: Publish the technical record
choices.description: Use a canalwright's pressure proof and the two documents to expose Vask without putting Mara in the case.

choices.label: Compel Vask under oath
choices.description: Use the safe-conduct oath to make Vask answer while Mara remains protected.

choices.label: Seal Mara's testimony
choices.description: Protect Mara by sealing her testimony. Vask keeps his post and the order's authority remains available.

choices.label: Negotiate a provisional record
choices.description: File the ledger and seal as a protected lead. Do not expose Vask or ask Mara to testify today.

choices.label: Adjourn and investigate further
choices.description: Return to the Archive hall for missing evidence before choosing a verdict. Existing testimony and protection remain; adjourning costs no resources.

choices.label: Leave the hearing undecided
choices.description: Walk away before the Archive records a verdict.

outcome.summary: You leave the Lantern hearing undecided. Vask's office keeps its clean record for now.

choices.label: Finish this journey: close the Archive case
choices.description: Close the Archive case here and finish this journey with Lowsail living with the evidence, protection, and risk you chose.

outcome.summary: You close the Lantern Archive case after carrying its verdict back to Lowsail. The order, the witness, and the town's water now share one record.

choices.label: Visit the Reedway shores
choices.description: Visit Reedway's shores and Sera Vale's crew. Travel costs nothing; you can return here with the Archive verdict unchanged.

choices.label: Return to Lowsail after Blackglass
choices.description: Return to Lowsail at no cost, keeping the Archive verdict and your work at Blackglass unchanged.

choices.label: Leave Lowsail with the record open
choices.description: Leave the town before accepting the Archive's final account.

outcome.summary: You leave Lowsail with the Lantern record open. The town keeps the consequences without your final answer.

choices.label: Continue this journey at Blackglass Works
choices.description: Carry the closed Archive record to Blackglass Works and continue the same journey through its pressure works.

choices.label: Enter the Blackglass Works
choices.description: Take the pressure map from Nessa and cross the reedway before the next tide mark.

choices.label: Leave Blackglass for now
choices.description: Turn back before taking responsibility for the pressure line.

outcome.summary: You leave Blackglass before entering the works. The pressure line and its next failure remain upriver.

choices.label: Return to Lowsail with the pressure account
choices.description: Bring Orin's working line and Nessa's marks back to the town that sent you.

choices.label: Visit the Blackglass dispatch board
choices.description: Carry Reedway's warning into the Blackglass dispatch room before you close the pressure account.

choices.label: Revisit the Blackglass dispatch board
choices.description: Return to the board and see how the published or quiet warning changed the works.

choices.label: Leave the works behind
choices.description: Depart after the pressure line is set, leaving the full account for someone else to carry.

outcome.summary: You leave Blackglass after setting the line. The works keep the pressure account, but Lowsail hears only the part you carried back.

choices.label: Take Varo's guarded catwalk
choices.description: Use the council's route through the watchpost. Tide +1; Varo will ask for a recorded favor at the gate.

choices.label: Take Nessa's maintenance line
choices.description: Follow the shared repair marks through the conduit while the current and patrols are low. Tide +1; the line stays quiet.

choices.label: Follow Orin's family rope line
choices.description: Use the evacuation route into the workers' barracks. Tide +1; Orin can keep the line together.

choices.label: Take the workers' line without Nessa
choices.description: Use Orin's rope line after Mara's coerced testimony. Tide +1; Nessa stays back until you repair the trust.

choices.label: Cross the exposed flood road
choices.description: Take the open road to the watchpost. Tide +1 and Risk +1; every patrol will see the crossing.

choices.label: Cross by the road already opened
choices.description: Use the exposed road again. Tide +1; the watch already knows you are here, so this adds no new Risk.

choices.label: Return to the Blackglass quay
choices.description: Step back to the quay and reconsider the route. Returning costs no supplies, debt, or risk.

choices.label: Show the council seal
choices.description: Open Varo's gate with the seal. Tide +1 and Debt +1; the watch records the favor against you.

choices.label: Wait for the watch to turn
choices.description: Wait beneath the rain cover until the lamps turn away. Tide +2 with no added Risk; the surge will arrive before you reach the controls.

choices.label: Run the watchline
choices.description: Run straight through the gate before the next sweep. Tide +1 and Risk +1; you save time, but Varo hears the gate chain shake.

choices.label: Return to the reedway
choices.description: Step away from Varo's lamps and choose the crossing again. Returning costs no supplies, debt, or risk.

choices.label: Follow the shared repair marks
choices.description: Use Nessa's brace while the current and patrols are low. Tide +1 with no added Risk; a rough approach cannot use this mark.

choices.label: Move before the lantern patrol
choices.description: Use the short ledge while the patrol looks outward. Tide +1 and Risk +1; reaching Risk 3 forces a scarred repair without Nessa's aid.

choices.label: Brace the conduit ledge
choices.description: Spend one supply on rope and canvas to quiet the ledge. Tide +1; current Risk stays unchanged.

choices.label: Use the sealed Archive cover
choices.description: Follow the protected signal through the gallery. Tide +1 with no added Risk.

choices.label: Use the provisional Archive route
choices.description: Take the quiet route left by the provisional record. Tide +1 with no added Risk.

choices.label: Ride the rising conduit
choices.description: Take the wet ladder while the current is moving. Tide +2 and Risk +1; reaching Tide 3 means an emergency release and pressure damage.

choices.label: Return to the reedway
choices.description: Leave the gallery ledge and reconsider the crossing. Returning costs no supplies, debt, or risk.

choices.label: Ask Nessa to hold the rope
choices.description: Let Nessa lead the workers through the last turn. Tide +1; her aid makes the pressure sequence safer.

choices.label: Spend a supply to repair Nessa's trust
choices.description: Give up one supply and let Nessa see the repair in action. Tide +1; her aid returns after Mara was compelled.

choices.label: Lead the workers before the surge
choices.description: Take Orin's signals and move before the next tide mark. Tide +1 with no added Risk.

choices.label: Take the workers through the flood
choices.description: Move without Nessa's full cover while the water is up. Tide +2 and Risk +1.

choices.label: Return to the reedway
choices.description: Leave Orin's barracks and reconsider the crossing. Returning costs no supplies, debt, or risk.

choices.label: Set the pressure before the next surge
choices.description: Turn the handwheels in Orin's sequence. Tide +1; with Risk 2 or lower, the line settles cleanly.

choices.label: Let Nessa balance the valve
choices.description: Give Nessa the final wheel. Her repair knowledge can steady the line even after a hard crossing.

choices.label: Let Nessa hold the emergency valve
choices.description: Give Nessa the wheel after the tide has filled the room. The line survives, but the surge leaves a pressure scar.

choices.label: Hold the valve under watch
choices.description: Keep the line moving while patrols close in. Tide +1; Risk 3 or higher leaves a pressure scar.

choices.label: Open the emergency bypass
choices.description: Release the surge before it tears through the shutters. Tide is already full; Risk +1 and the line will carry a scar.

choices.label: Leave the control room
choices.description: Abandon the pressure sequence while Orin holds the lower shutters.

outcome.summary: You leave the Blackglass control room before the pressure is set. Orin can only hold the shutters for so long.

choices.label: Leave the workers behind
choices.description: Depart from the barracks before taking the pressure line through the works.

outcome.summary: You leave Orin Pell's workers in the barracks. The pressure route remains unfinished.

choices.label: Leave the conduit gallery
choices.description: Turn back from the wet ledge before reaching the pressure room.

outcome.summary: You leave the conduit gallery before the pressure sequence. Blackglass keeps its rising water.

choices.label: Publish the Reedway warning
choices.description: Spend one supply to put the warning on every Blackglass watch roster.

choices.label: Keep the warning with the night crew
choices.description: Add one Risk to keep Reedway's warning off the public board and preserve the quiet route.

choices.label: Leave the dispatch board
choices.description: Return to Lowsail's account without deciding how widely the warning should travel.

choices.label: Finish this journey: clean Blackglass account
choices.description: Record the settled pressure line and finish this journey here with Lowsail's clean account.

outcome.summary: You close the Blackglass account with the pressure line steady. The works are ready for another shift, and Lowsail has your report.

choices.label: Finish this journey: watched Blackglass account
choices.description: Record the steady line and finish this journey here. The pressure holds, but the watch will follow the route.

outcome.summary: You close the Blackglass account with the pressure line steady but watched. The route holds, and every patrol now knows its cost.

choices.label: Finish this journey: scarred Blackglass account
choices.description: Record that the line holds after the hard crossing, including its risk and attention, and finish this journey here.

outcome.summary: You close the Blackglass account after a scarred crossing. The line holds, but the watch and the pressure will shape every return.

choices.label: Leave Lowsail with the account open
choices.description: Depart before choosing how the Blackglass pressure line should shape the next journey.

outcome.summary: You leave Lowsail after Blackglass without closing the new account. The pressure line holds, and its consequences wait.

choices.label: Explore the Reedway shores
choices.description: Visit the clinic annex, worker landing and stranded barge within this journey. Travel costs nothing; you can return to Lowsail and finish whenever you wish.

choices.label: Walk to the Reedway commons
choices.description: Visit the Reedway commons within this journey. Travel costs nothing; you can return to Blackglass or Lowsail whenever you wish.

choices.label: Return to the open Archive case
choices.description: Return to the Archive landing at no cost. Your case remains open, keeping its evidence and everything you have done in Reedway.

choices.label: Return to the Archive record
choices.description: Return to your Archive record in Lowsail at no cost, keeping its verdict and everything you have done in Reedway. The shores remain open to you.

choices.label: Visit the stranded barge
choices.description: Talk to Sera Vale about the surviving regulator, her injured deckhand and the salvage claim.

choices.label: Visit Ilyra's annex
choices.description: Hear what the regulator would make possible and handle the annex patients if you can.

choices.label: Visit Orin's landing
choices.description: Hear what the regulator would make possible and decide how relief will reach the workers.

choices.label: Visit the upper-bank watch
choices.description: Carry a flood warning to the crews above the reed flats. The ferry horn and Sera's quiet towpath ask different prices.

choices.label: Revisit the warned upper-bank watch
choices.description: Return to the watch and see how the ferry warning changed the upper-bank preparations.

choices.label: Revisit the quiet upper-bank watch
choices.description: Return to the watch and see what the quiet towpath warning changed for the next crew.

choices.label: Return to Lowsail
choices.description: Return to the town with your pressure account. You can finish the journey there or come back to the shores.

choices.label: Return to Blackglass Quay
choices.description: Revisit the settled works and the people waiting at the quay.

choices.label: Finish this journey: close the clinic account
choices.description: Finish your journey with Ilyra's annex sterilizer running. Any open Archive investigation ends unfinished.

outcome.summary: You leave Ilyra's sterilizer running. The annex can keep its treatment benches open, while Orin's crew still hauls the heavy ferry loads by hand.

choices.label: Finish this journey: close the ferry account
choices.description: Finish your journey with Orin's heavy worker transport running. Any open Archive investigation ends unfinished.

outcome.summary: You leave a working freight ferry at the upper bank. Orin's crew can move heavy loads again; Ilyra's annex still relies on hand-boiled instruments.

choices.label: Return to the commons
choices.description: Leave the salvage site and visit either shore.

choices.label: Return to the commons
choices.description: Leave the annex and visit the worker landing or salvage site.

choices.label: Return to the commons
choices.description: Leave the landing and visit the clinic or salvage site.

choices.label: Buy the regulator from Sera
choices.description: Spend one supply to honor Sera's salvage claim, then carry the regulator back to the commons. Her crew will keep its discounted relief route.

choices.label: Accept Sera's work lien
choices.description: Take the regulator against one debt mark, up to the debt ceiling of four, then carry it back to the commons. Sera's crew keeps its discounted relief route.

choices.label: Seize the regulator
choices.description: Take the part over Sera's objection and carry it back to the commons without paying her. Her discounted relief transport will no longer be available.

choices.label: Repair Sera's pump in exchange for the part
choices.description: Use one unit of clean water and your canalwright training to restore Sera's bilge pump in exchange for the regulator. Carry it back to the commons; her crew keeps its discounted relief route.

choices.label: Trade the repair kit for the regulator
choices.description: Give Sera one repair kit for the part, then carry the regulator back to the commons. Her crew will keep its discounted relief route.

choices.label: Treat Milo's injured hand
choices.description: Spend one medicine to dress and support Milo's hand. Sera will cooperate with your relief work, even if you took the regulator over her objection.

choices.label: Splint Milo's hand as a field medic
choices.description: Use your training and one supply to support Milo's injured hand. Sera will cooperate with your relief work, even after the seizure.

choices.label: Install the regulator in Ilyra's sterilizer
choices.description: Use the regulator to restore the sterilizer permanently. Ilyra gives you two medicine from her reserve; the ferry will keep hauling by hand.

choices.label: Treat the patients with medicine
choices.description: Spend one medicine to treat the annex patients before or after the sterilizer is powered.

choices.label: Treat the patients with a supply kit
choices.description: Give Ilyra two supplies for fuel and fresh dressings so she can treat the patients with equipment boiled by hand.

choices.label: Triage the patients as a field medic
choices.description: Spend one supply and use your field-medic practice to treat the annex patients.

choices.label: Order imported sterile packs
choices.description: Add two debt marks for imported packs, up to the debt ceiling of four, and treat the patients without spending supplies.

choices.label: Install the regulator in Orin's ferry
choices.description: Use the regulator to restore heavy transport. Orin gives you two supplies from the newly unloaded freight; the annex will keep sterilizing by hand.

choices.label: Send relief with Sera's crew
choices.description: Spend one supply and use Sera's discounted route while her cooperation holds.

choices.label: Haul relief with porters
choices.description: Spend two supplies to send relief with hired porters. Sera has refused to lend her crew after the seizure.

choices.label: Commission Sera's crew on credit
choices.description: Add one debt mark, up to the debt ceiling of four, to commission Sera's crew while her cooperation holds.

choices.label: Commission porters on credit
choices.description: Add two debt marks to hire porters after Sera's refusal. New credit cannot take your total Debt above four.

choices.label: Sound the warning by ferry horn
choices.description: Spend one supply to fuel Orin's signal boat and send the flood warning across the upper bank.

choices.label: Carry the warning by quiet towpath
choices.description: Use Sera's quiet route and add one Risk to reach the upper-bank watch before the patrol lamps return.

choices.label: Return to the commons
choices.description: Leave the upper-bank watch and return to the Reedway commons.
